## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Related issue

Link the issue or explain why one is not required.

## Validation

- [ ] TypeScript typecheck passed.
- [ ] Frontend tests passed.
- [ ] Production frontend build passed.
- [ ] Rust tests passed, or I explained why they were not run.
- [ ] Rust Clippy passed, or I explained why it was not run.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has regression coverage.

## Integrity and data review

- [ ] Blind evidence remains separated from Reveal and target data.
- [ ] AI Judge inputs remain allowlisted and scoring remains `3 + 3 + 2 + 2`.
- [ ] Research lock, score freeze, and unblinding order remain protected.
- [ ] Provider reasoning remains separate from final assistant content.
- [ ] Viewer Notes identity, version, timing, and Research controls remain protected.
- [ ] Database changes use an additive migration and include integrity tests.
- [ ] No credentials, private targets, transcripts, database files, or generated build output are included.

## Documentation and compatibility

- [ ] User-facing documentation and translations were updated where needed.
- [ ] Architecture documentation was updated if an invariant changed.
- [ ] Provider, platform, and migration compatibility considerations are described below.

## Additional notes

List checks not run, known limitations, screenshots, or migration details.
